# HomieBytes

> Order fresh homemade meals from cooks in your neighbourhood. HomieBytes is a marketplace connecting home cooks with hungry customers across India, with rider-powered delivery.

HomieBytes lets customers browse dishes by cuisine, dietary preference, price, and rating, then order from verified home cooks. Cooks list their menu, and riders pick up and deliver orders.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured dishes, cuisines, and promos.
- [Browse](/browse): Search and filter all available homemade dishes.
